narrative:
Tuscarawas County has 56,479 registered voters, with 57.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 23.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 19.2%, a modest Republican lean of 4.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.9% of registrants.
